author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
change: Role.FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT, the Pose subject type and FootprintPolicy are REMOVED from src/navfm/candidate_policy.py.
reason: FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT was removed because SD-001 places non-target volumetric footprint operations outside candidate_policy.py. It accepted a robot Pose, declared no target and adjudicated no collider identity, so it asked the volumetric question -- can this robot volume occupy this space -- rather than the target-directed one this module owns.
digest_must_change: removing a role changes the serialized policy record, and the digest exists to make exactly that visible; a scope correction that left the digest alone would tell a later reader the intervention set was unchanged when a role had left it

serialization_delta.verified: the complete diff between the v3 and v4 canonical records is these two items and nothing else, checked by comparing the serialized dicts directly

unchanged_semantics_verified_against_fro.BLOCKER_DEFAULT: 4/4 candidates identical in origin, direction and range
unchanged_semantics_verified_against_fro.SUPPORT_DEFAULT: identical in origin, direction and range
unchanged_semantics_verified_against_fro.validity_semantics: unchanged; degenerate axis still yields a retained INVALID candidate

candidate_identity_note: candidate_id embeds the policy digest, so every candidate id changes with the digest. That is intended: an id is evidence identity, and evidence produced under a different policy is different evidence. The face labels, ordering, origins, directions and ranges are unchanged.
consumers_affected: none -- no consumer called Role.FOOTPRINT_SUPPORT, verified by repository-wide search before removal
claim_boundary: Concerns module scope and policy provenance only. No scene was measured, no consumer was migrated, and no scene verdict changed.
